title: Prove the two-short-row connector obstruction for every modulus
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof for balanced unsigned depth-four dirty chain connectors, produced by Nick Petalas. This extends #4280's prime-characteristic obstruction to every modulus and supplies a new infinite composite-characteristic construction.

```text
two short rows  =>  m | cL for each short-row length L
unit c         =>  at least three short rows
m = 8t, c = 4t =>  exactly two short rows and exactly 4m calls, for every t >= 1
```

The necessary condition is not claimed sufficient. The written proof carries both unbounded results; the finite replay checks the new words and an arithmetic relaxation. Only `research/depth4-two-row-obstruction/` is added. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before: #4280 proves the two-short-row obstruction only when m is prime and gives finite 4m witnesses through m = 64. After: the unit-coefficient obstruction applies to every modulus, while the explicit m = 8t family attains 4m calls with two short rows for every t.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only:

- 64 constructed family words, t = 1..64: balanced counts, all chronological interval conditions and separate UT5 products pass.
- 128 literal replays with dirty registers and noncommuting 2-by-2 maps restore all intermediates and give the required target gain.
- 436,358 tuples in the necessary two-row algebraic relaxation, including 235,610 with nonzero c: annihilator and divisibility checks pass. These tuples are not claimed to be realizable profile records.
- 17 rejection controls pass. Normal and optimized registered commands each take less than one second; exported isolated replays take 0.251 s and 0.255 s.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with source-history ancestry, and eight-file committed-export integrity pass at `44640c4a9538d5565d33e6dc218889f130143ce7`. The exported verifier passes normally and under `-O`. Receipts are generated from package and input hashes.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/depth4-two-row-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/depth4-two-row-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/depth4-two-row-obstruction
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/depth4-two-row-obstruction --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 can replace the local interpreter path. The verifier writes no files and imports no predecessor code.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem concerns balanced unsigned depth-four words and their row-model complexity. It does not classify all two-row nonunit targets, prove a uniform three-row construction for unit targets, or settle the 4m conjecture for every m and c. The all-modulus statements are written proofs, not conclusions extrapolated from the finite domain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No Lean build or selected cold replay was run. Physical routing, storage, precision, admission and a recursive supplier caller remain unpriced; no complete multiplication theorem follows.

## Open next questions

1. Which nonzero coefficients admit exactly two short rows? Enumerate the monotone profiles for a fixed pair L and m-L after applying the new divisibility condition. The condition is not proved sufficient.
2. Can three short rows realize every unit coefficient for every m >= 6? The new result proves necessity; a uniform construction must retain the rho and beta budgets.

## Related open work

Refreshed this account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22 09:15:33 UTC and read every returned body. Apart from this PR, the results are:

- #4597 proves a block-Schur commutator identity and sharp rank bound. It does not compute depth-four connector row complexity or call counts; no numerical overlap.
- #4598 counts five-request binary threshold headers. Complete-header counts and densities are different quantities from this package's short-row and call counts; no numerical overlap.
- #4599 proves a four-request binary full-guard product inequality. It computes header probabilities, with no overlapping connector quantity.
- #4601 gives right-vector factor costs over local products. Its factor alphabet and targets differ from this dirty-chain model; no numerical overlap.

No newer account PR studies this depth-four short-row question, so no cross-PR numeric equality check applies to this refresh. Historical and unpublished coverage remains partial.

Merged predecessors: #4280 supplies the row criterion and prime-modulus lemma; #4249 supplies the interval floor; #4263 supplies the earlier depth-four witnesses. Their 4m values agree numerically with the new family at m = 8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64: lengths 32,64,96,128,160,192,224,256. This package checks its own new words and does not audit their tables. Credit Nick Petalas for these predecessors and Ross Richardson for the #943/#934 complete-call connector lineage. Exact base, source blobs and hashes are in `SOURCES.json`.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19119351

## CI notes

CI blocked by main for head `44640c4a9538d5565d33e6dc218889f130143ce7`. In [run 39755207549](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39755207549), `plan` failed in **Onboarding helper tests**. The log reports 331 tests, four failures and 11 skips. The package `replay` job was **skipped**, so hosted CI has not certified this package. Local verification stands as already recorded above.

The four failures are all in `tests/test_research_current_status.py`:

- `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the current CI navigation section lacks the selected `make frontier4359-verify` command.
- `test_current_section_matches_selected_record`: the status section contains `**0.0023 = 23/10000**`, while the assertion requires the literal `**0.0023**`.
- `test_history_banner_precedes_historical_sections`: the opening section lacks the required `historical snapshot` banner.
- `test_only_the_first_heading_claims_current_or_selected`: `## Historical selected status through #1094` still contains `selected`.

All four reproduce from the exact test and document/record inputs exported from unchanged `origin/main` at `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1`. The focused local command `/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py -v` runs six tests with these same four failures and two passes. The export and reproduction log are outside the checkout.

The independently inspected logs of two other contributors' runs have the same four failures and assertions, each reporting 331 tests, four failures and 11 skips:

- [check-4585, run 39754840618](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39754840618), head `81b302ecda3e24893debf3cf8013867c3a0cbf30`, from pinterbanget.
- [research/receiver-all-length-floor, run 39746873103](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39746873103), head `4f05085bfd3ef9f7ab54a4c30c0d6bd84bd4333c`, from mihir-s-05.

This is a shared onboarding/documentation failure, independent of the new package. No shared file, package file or commit was changed. DONE remains pending green CI; scratch evidence is retained.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated package. No shared code, pinned predecessor, upstream archive or selected record changes.
